name: rating-mark
title: Rating Mark
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: The one star recipe. Draws a 0-5 rating as characters so it inherits colour and size from its caption, and announces itself to a screen reader as a number rather than as five shapes. Halves round to the nearest half star.
docs: Never default `value`. A star mark is a factual claim about a real review; a component that defaults to 5 invents evidence every time a caller omits it. Omit the rating and draw nothing.
